meta.method: UK accounts downloaded from the Charity Commission for England & Wales register (url = direct download; register list page in accountsListUrl). Tables read from page images rendered from the PDF, not from the text layer. 'page' = printed page number unless marked 'PDF p'. No NI share computed or apportioned from UK totals.
scope_notes: NI public bodies' own grant/contract lists (Belfast City Council, EA, PHA contracts awarded, Supporting People) were NOT opened in this pass; every funder amount below comes from the charity's own accounts.
Companies House searched by name for NI-prefixed companies for each charity (first results page per query only).
NI Assembly evidence: only the Barnardo's NI Oct 2021 written submission was opened.

niActivity.text: Barnardo's NI is the largest children's charity in Northern Ireland. Every year we work with more than 18,000 children, young people and families across more than 45 different services and programmes.
niActivity.note: This is the source of the '18,000' figure: Barnardo's NI written evidence to the NI Assembly Committee for Health on the Adoption and Children Bill, dated October 2021. The same wording ('over 18,000 ... 45+ services') is the undated profile text on Barnardo's NI's LinkedIn and Facebook pages. It is a 2021 figure, NOT 2024-25. The 2024-25 annual report gives 49,800 through 74 services (p14), so do not use 18,000 as current.
